targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(thermal.ambient_temp) AS "thermal/ambient_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.coolant_temp) AS "thermal/coolant_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.motor_temp) AS "thermal/motor_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.inverter_temp) AS "thermal/inverter_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.batt_loop_batt_temp) AS "thermal/batt_loop_batt_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.motor_loop_motor_temp) AS "thermal/motor_loop_motor_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.motor_loop_inverter_temp) AS "thermal/motor_loop_inverter_temp [C]" FROM thermal JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = thermal.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(thermal.module_a_temp) AS "thermal/module_a_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.module_b_temp) AS "thermal/module_b_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.module_c_temp) AS "thermal/module_c_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.gate_driver_temp) AS "thermal/gate_driver_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.inverter_hotspot_temp) AS "thermal/inverter_hotspot_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.discharge_r_temp) AS "thermal/discharge_r_temp [C]", AVG(diagnostics_low.precharge_r_temp) AS "thermal/precharge_r_temp [C]" FROM thermal JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = thermal.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true LEFT JOIN diagnostics_low ON diagnostics_low.packet_id = thermal.packet_id WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(thermal.batt_loop_rad_fan_speed) AS "thermal/batt_loop_rad_fan_speed", AVG(thermal.motor_loop_rad_fan_speed) AS "thermal/motor_loop_rad_fan_speed", AVG(thermal.batt_loop_rad_temp) AS "thermal/batt_loop_rad_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.motor_loop_rad_temp) AS "thermal/motor_loop_rad_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.batt_cooling_current) AS "thermal/batt_cooling_current [A]", AVG(thermal.motor_cooling_current) AS "thermal/motor_cooling_current [A]" FROM thermal JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = thermal.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ), cell_t AS (SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, UNNEST(pack.cells_temps) AS value FROM pack JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = pack.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end), thermal_t AS (SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(thermal.cell_top_temp) AS cell_top_temp, AVG(thermal.cell_bottom_temp) AS cell_bottom_temp, AVG(thermal.bus_bar_temp1) AS bus_bar_temp1, AVG(thermal.bus_bar_temp2) AS bus_bar_temp2, AVG(thermal.bus_bar_temp3) AS bus_bar_temp3 FROM thermal JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = thermal.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1), diag_t AS (SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(diagnostics_low.precharge_r_temp) AS precharge_r_temp FROM diagnostics_low JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = diagnostics_low.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1) SELECT cell_t.time, AVG(cell_t.value) AS "hvc/cells_temp_avg [C]", MIN(cell_t.value) AS "hvc/cells_temp_min [C]", MAX(cell_t.value) AS "hvc/cells_temp_max [C]", MAX(thermal_t.cell_top_temp) AS "hvc/cell_top_temp [C]", MAX(thermal_t.cell_bottom_temp) AS "hvc/cell_bottom_temp [C]", MAX(thermal_t.bus_bar_temp1) AS "hvc/bus_bar_temp1 [C]", MAX(thermal_t.bus_bar_temp2) AS "hvc/bus_bar_temp2 [C]", MAX(thermal_t.bus_bar_temp3) AS "hvc/bus_bar_temp3 [C]", MAX(diag_t.precharge_r_temp) AS "hvc/precharge_r_temp [C]" FROM cell_t LEFT JOIN thermal_t ON thermal_t.time = cell_t.time LEFT JOIN diag_t ON diag_t.time = cell_t.time GROUP BY cell_t.time ORDER BY cell_t.time;
